headline: 戴蒙新書挑戰個人史觀
context: 《槍炮、病菌與鋼鐵》作者賈德．戴蒙（Jared Diamond）出版新書《Profits, Prophets, Coaches and Kings》，探討關鍵人物是否真的能改變歷史走向。書評指出，戴蒙提出的「哈姆雷特測試」論證有明顯漏洞——他認為莎士比亞獨一無二，卻忽略了同代劇作家馬羅（Christopher Marlowe）29歲就遇刺身亡，未必沒有機會寫出同等傑作。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: The author of Guns, Germs and Steel falters in this flawed study of whether individuals really make a difference Early in this book, Jared Diamond proudly introduces “what I term ‘the Hamlet test’”, which helps decide whether prominent individuals really make a difference, or whether others might have done just as well. Among William Shakespeare’s contemporaries on the Elizabethan stage, he explains, were “Ben Jonson, Christopher Marlowe and John Webster. But not even their best plays remotely approach in quality Hamlet and Shakespeare’s other masterpieces.” It follows, for Diamond, that Shakespeare was indeed “uniquely talented”: “We can be confident that no Elizabethan other than Shakespeare could have written a masterpiece like Hamlet if Shakespeare hadn’t done so.” One obvious problem with this is that Marlowe was stabbed to death in a pub in Deptford in 1593 at the age of 29, having already written the absolute bangers Doctor Faustus and Tamburlaine, as well as – so it is now thought – co-writing the Henry VI trilogy with the up-and-coming Shakespeare. Shakespeare himself did not begin to compose his major tragedies, including Hamlet, until he was a decade older. So we can’t rule out the possibility that, had Marlowe lived another 10 years, he would have matched or even exceeded his colleague’s genius. Scholars widely agree that Hamlet and Shakespeare’s other masterpieces were possible only thanks to the outsized influence of Marlowe. Continue reading...

thread_text:
戴蒙新書談歷史是否由個人推動。《槍炮、病菌與鋼鐵》作者賈德．戴蒙出版新書《Profits, Prophets, Coaches and Kings》，探討關鍵人物是否真能改變歷史。書評認為他提出的「哈姆雷特測試」論證有漏洞——戴蒙推崇莎士比亞獨一無二，卻忽略同代劇作家馬羅29歲遇刺身亡，未必沒機會寫出同等傑作。

—— 本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 9 月 2 日發佈的書評，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。
threads_text:
《槍炮、病菌與鋼鐵》作者賈德．戴蒙（Jared Diamond）推出新書《Profits, Prophets, Coaches and Kings》，探討傑出領袖或個人，究竟是不是真的能改變歷史走向。書評指出，戴蒙書中提出的「哈姆雷特測試」論證存在明顯漏洞：他認為同時代沒人能寫出《哈姆雷特》，因此莎士比亞是獨一無二的天才；但同代劇作家馬羅（Christopher Marlowe）29歲就遭刺殺身亡，此前已寫出多部傑作，若他多活十年，未必不能達到同等成就。

本則整理自 The Guardian 與 The New York Times 於 2026 年 9 月 2 日發佈的書評。
voice_text: 歷史是不是靠幾個天才人物推動的？《槍炮、病菌與鋼鐵》的作者賈德．戴蒙，新書裡就在問這個問題。不過書評不太買帳。戴蒙認為莎士比亞是獨一無二的天才，因為同時代沒人寫得出《哈姆雷特》這種等級的作品。但書評指出一個問題——莎士比亞的同代劇作家馬羅，29歲就遇刺身亡，當時已經寫出好幾部傑作。如果他多活十年，誰知道會寫出什麼呢。
